purpose: Explain that governed AI work moves from signal through a policy decision to durable proof.

who.appearance: small cobalt geometric object, tactile matte material

who.role: durable evidence of the approved action
who.appearance: small optic-white physical card with embossed non-legible marks

what.action: The signal enters a clear channel, pauses while the gate evaluates it, crosses the opened boundary, leaves a visible wake, and causes a proof receipt to click into place.
what.claim: AI work shouldn't just run. It should leave proof.

where.set: three clear acrylic channels on a near-black technical surface

when.lighting: timeless controlled laboratory, hard raking key light, crisp reflections, deep black background

beats.label: signal
beats.action: The cobalt signal enters the first clear channel in deliberate stop-motion steps.

beats.label: decision
beats.action: The signal pauses at the policy gate; the mechanism inspects, clicks, and opens.

beats.label: proof
beats.action: The signal crosses the boundary and leaves one clean physical wake in the downstream channel.

beats.label: receipt
beats.action: An optic-white proof card clicks into its final slot; focus transfers to it.

camera.path: single slow left-to-right lateral track following the signal
camera.pushIn: subtle continuous push-in from 2 to 9 seconds
camera.focus: track the signal through 9 seconds, then rack focus to the proof receipt

motion.cadence: 12 unique poses per second, each held for two frames in the 24 fps delivery
motion.water: stepped replacement-animation shapes rather than smooth fluid simulation

voiceover.line: AI work shouldn't just run. It should leave proof.
voiceover.timing: begin after the signal enters and finish before the receipt clicks
